content.text: This is clearly a feature flag toggle: `monthly-spend-feature` flipped from off to on at 07:16:00Z, immediately followed by ZeroDivisionError in spend_summary.py:47, causing the error rate spike. No deployment occurred in this window (get_changes returned empty), confirming this is a flag flip, not a code/config deploy.

hypotheses.subject: monthly-spend-feature
hypotheses.summary: The monthly-spend-feature flag was toggled from off to on at 07:16:00Z, which enabled a code path (spend_summary.py:47) that throws a ZeroDivisionError on account page requests, immediately spiking the error rate from baseline (~1%) to over 30%. No deployment or config change occurred in this window, and CPU/capacity metrics show no saturation or leak, ruling out resource-based causes.

supporting_evidence.claim: ERROR io-shop: account page request failed - ZeroDivisionError: division by zero at src/io_shop/spend_summary.py:47
error_rate jumped from 0.005 at 07:15:00Z to 0.34 at 07:16:00Z while cpu_used_cores/cpu_limit_cores and request_volume stayed flat
